name: Bach Dang promenade
kicker: The promenade for a coffee and a walk
summary: Walk the Han on Bach Dang, the riverside promenade of cafes, with a coffee or a young coconut in hand. It is busiest in the early morning and late afternoon, and packed on weekend nights before the Dragon Bridge breathes fire at 21:00. An hour is enough, and the walk is free.
getThere: On foot if you slept on the river. A Grab from My Khe.
heroCaption: The promenade along the Han, under the hotel towers

notice.title: Weekend nights are crowded
notice.body: On Friday, Saturday, and Sunday the sidewalk fills before the 21:00 dragon show. Come earlier for a cafe seat.

body: This is the river walk, and one of the city's walking streets. Start with a coffee and a young coconut, then keep going along the cafes that face the Han. It is busiest in the early morning and late afternoon.

On a Friday, Saturday, or Sunday the same walk ends at the dragon, which breathes fire at 21:00. The swing bridge is the other night, later. Han Market, at 119 Tran Phu, is the hall when you want the market instead of a cafe.
Look down the path from the trees and the hotel line to the water. The walk is the strip at the river, not a shopping street.

figures.caption: Fishing boats on the Han, from the east bank
figures.alt: Fishing boats on the Han River with the far bank and a bridge in the haze

gettingThere: Stay on the river and the promenade is the sidewalk. From My Khe, take a Grab to Bach Dang.
hours: Open walk. Busiest early morning and late afternoon (city portal, 2016). Cafe hours: check on arrival.
closed: No closing hour for the walk.
